eligibility: Good health and good character; respect Chinese habits and customs; obey Chinese law and university rules.
Non-Chinese citizen aged 18–45, holding a valid foreign passport.
Second year of university or above.
Chinese proficiency at the subject-dependent HSK 4/5 threshold or the stated Chinese-medium qualification evidence exemption.

materials.value: BNU International Students Application Form completed through the official online application system.
Passport bio page; applicants who have a Chinese visa also supply the recent visa page.
Final degree certificate or certificate of enrollment.
Transcript of the final academic study period.
HSK certificate and transcript, or an institution-issued certificate that the previous/current qualification was taught in Chinese.
A teacher's recommendation letter; no fixed format, but it must carry the teacher's signature.
RMB 450 application fee paid through the applicant's personal online account; non-refundable.

documentConditions: All application documents must be Chinese or English; documents in other languages require notarized Chinese or English translations.
Applicants attending a higher education institution in China during application must, if admitted, supply its completion or graduation certificate at registration.
After preliminary review, download and print the system-generated application form, sign it and email its scan to nondegree@bnu.edu.cn according to instructions.
An online interview may be required.
